thread:
jamal: Enabled the FP8 kernel variant on a small H100 + L40S subset for model-orion-13b. Shadow traffic ~2% for 2h. Seeing mixed signals — latency down on median but tail spikes and a tiny quality delta on our dev QA set.
meera: What do you mean by mixed signals? numbers? :thinking_face:
jamal: Quick snapshot: median token latency H100: 28ms -> 22ms with FP8. L40S: 31ms -> 24ms. But 95p spikes: H100 120ms -> 680ms intermittently; L40S 140ms -> 900ms.
liam: That's a huge tail. Any correlation with GPU clocks/thermal events?
jamal: Yup — traces show GPU clock drop events ~every 10-20m on some L40S nodes. Stack traces point to the FP8 fused attention kernel taking a slow path when clocks throttle.
alexa: Did the eval suite show actual output regression or just metric noise?
jamal: Small but consistent QA EM drop: SQuAD EM baseline 82.4% -> 80.8% (delta -1.6). Perplexity on eval set +0.4. Not catastrophic but repeatable on long-context prompts (>2048).
priya: Is the delta present for FP8 on H100 only, or both? could be kernel implementation assuming steady clocks.
jamal: Seen on both, worse on L40S. Hypothesis: reduced accum precision + variable clock leads to different reduction ordering -> rounding noise accumulates for long KV chains.
liam: Can you paste the kernel config we used?
jamal: Sure:
```
runtime: fp8_fused_attention
quant_profile: fp8-e4m3
tiling: kv-32x64
kv-cache-mode: shared
threading: auto
```
liam: Suggest toggling `tiling` to kv-16x128 and re-run short shadow to check numerical stability. Also try deterministic accumulation on the fused kernel if supported.
meera: We need recommendations for rollout: block chatty conversation workloads until we understand tail. Those show the biggest regressions.
ate: @nate here — can we get perf counters and nv-hostengine logs around the spike window? Also collect `nvidia-smi dmon` and `dmesg` to check throttling.
jamal: Collected and attached (summary inline): GPU freq drops from 1.6GHz -> 700MHz during spike. Kernel runtime grows 8x. No OOMs, no NaNs.
priya: For short term: disable fp8 fused on L40S and route only latency-sensitive low-token requests to FP8 on H100. Keep FP16 fallback for long-contexts.
liam: We should also run an AWQ/GPTQ INT8 comparison on the same shadow to compare quality vs cost tradeoffs. Might avoid FP8 instabilities for these workloads.
alexa: Agree. Also add a canary cohort that pins `kv-cache-mode: per-request` to see if shared KV caching interaction is amplifying rounding error.
meera: I'll update canary policy: 2% shadow -> reduce to 0.5% active for H100 FP8, 0% for L40S until we validate. Add extra logging tracepoints for long-prefix sequences.
sre-bot: ALERT: fp8-kernel-tail-spike detected on 3 L40S instances. Autoremoved 0.5% traffic from FP8 pool. See incident-386501 for full dump. :robot_face:
jamal: Thanks. Plan: 1) rollback FP8 on L40S (done) 2) run targeted numeric stability sweep (tiling + accumulation modes) on H100 3) collect rerun evals (SQuAD + longform QA + perplexity) 4) compare AWQ/INT8 variants. Will report back with numbers.
meera: Thx — let’s keep the mitigation window open till the stability sweep finishes. If delta >1% EM we hold.
priya: If you need help with kernel patches I can prototype a clamp/normalize step in the reduce path to bound rounding drift. Low risk patch.
jamal: Appreciate it — scheduling a quick triage in 30m.
